title: Vector batch rollback cleanup can make the next recovery irrecoverable
description: atomic_json._recover_transaction restores and fsyncs all targets for a prepared transaction, then deletes backups while the journal still says prepared. A crash after deleting one backup but before deleting the journal makes the next recovery demand the now-missing backup and fail permanently even though rollback had completed. Durably checkpoint a rolled-back phase before cleanup (or equivalently make cleanup retry-safe), and add a crash-during-cleanup regression.
